items.bearing_surface: PAYE deduction timing and mechanics for the standard ACC earners' levy
items.defining_provision: ACC earners' levy deduction and pay-date guidance on Inland Revenue's salary-and-wages deductions page
items.reason: The guidance bears on collection of the certified earners' levy output, but the pinned RuleSpec module names the separate IRD levy-rate page and the 2025 regulations, not this deduction guidance.
items.title: Inland Revenue — Deductions from salary and wages

items.bearing_surface: GST treatment and GST-inclusive factor in the standard ACC earners' levy calculation
items.defining_provision: Goods and Services Tax Act 1985 ss 5(6EC)–(6EE), 8(1), and 10
items.reason: The Act makes the earners' levy a GST-bearing deemed supply and supplies the 15 percent tax factor; the current RuleSpec computes a GST-inclusive rate without proof-binding these provisions.
items.title: Goods and Services Tax Act 1985
